defects: Center-back estrade: the fqih's right hand is raised onto the upper crown of his turban rather than wiping his brow/forehead.
tiles.fix: Lower the fqih's right hand to his forehead/brow level so the brow-wiping gesture reads clearly.

defects: Foreground left: the red-capped boy has no visible slate in his hands and holds his right arm awkwardly out behind him with an open palm instead of fanning himself with his slate.
Center-back estrade: the fqih's right hand rests on the very top peak of his turban rather than wiping his brow.
tiles.fix: Keep the red-capped boy's slate in his hand near his face/chest in a fanning pose, and lower the fqih's right hand from the top of his turban to his brow.

defects: Center doorway: the little white-robed boy stands ahead of the fqih instead of behind him, overlapping the fqih's torso and occluding his right arm.
Center-left foreground: the white-robed boy stands stiffly facing straight at the camera and scales too large relative to the other boys compared to b010.
Right side by tomb railing: the other three boys are clustered far to the right facing left rather than entering through the sanctuary doorway behind the fqih.
tiles.fix: Stage the fqih walking in first through the doorway with all four boys—including a properly scaled white-robed boy—following in single/tight procession behind him from the door, slates held to chests.

defects: Procession staging: the white-robed boy is ahead of the fqih on the left, the red-capped boy stands beside the fqih, and the blue-robed and white-capped boys walk leftwards from the tomb on the right rather than coming in through the sanctuary door.
Foreground center-left: both the white-robed boy and red-capped boy face stiffly straight toward the camera instead of walking in procession, while the fqih's left arm hangs stiffly at his side.
Scale: the white-robed boy reads too large relative to the red-capped and blue-robed boys compared to b010.
tiles.fix: Re-path the boys to enter forward from the sanctuary door behind the fqih in natural walking poses, and scale down the white-robed boy to match his young size in b010.

defects: Center-right behind the red-dressed woman: the second woman (green/apron dress) has her visible right hand hanging at her waist/hip instead of counting on her fingers.
tiles.fix: Raise the second woman's hands to chest level in a finger-counting gesture as she walks around the tomb.

defects: Rightmost woman (green/apron dress): her hands are lowered/clasped at her waist instead of counting on her fingers, and her gaze turns slightly out toward the camera.
Staging: all three women are tightly grouped on the near side of the tomb rather than spaced along the circling lap.
tiles.fix: Raise the rightmost woman's hands to count on her fingers with her gaze directed toward her hands/the tomb, and space the three women further apart along the circling path.

defects: Center-right: the fqih holds a white handkerchief/cloth over his mouth and nose (leftover prop from b010) instead of placing his index finger to his lips to signal silence as required by b014.
Left-center: Mohammed's pose is awkward with his left forearm bent up in front of his chest while his right arm hangs down.
tiles.fix: Remove the white cloth prop from the fqih and animate him pressing a single finger clearly to his lips while looking down at the boys.

defects: Center-right: the fqih stands in the middle of the room with both forearms raised and empty cupped hands hovering stiffly in front of his chest in an unnatural leftover prop-holding pose.
Far left: the blue-robe boy bends at the fountain with his hands poised high near the wall spout above the basin with no visible water contact.
Left-center: Mohammed stands behind the blue-robe boy with stiff, slightly splayed A-pose arms.
tiles.fix: Relax the fqih's arms into a natural supervising posture and place the blue-robe boy's cupped hands clearly into the fountain basin stream.

defects: Center-right: Mohammed's arms angle outward away from his thighs in a stiff A-pose instead of resting naturally at his sides.
Center: the boys' prayer row is staggered in depth, with the blue-robe boy standing noticeably further forward toward the fqih than the red-cap boy and Mohammed.
tiles.fix: Align all four boys shoulder-to-shoulder on a straight row line and relax Mohammed's arms naturally against his sides.

defects: Center-right and far right: Mohammed and the white-cap boy turn their heads sideways toward the fqih instead of facing forward in qiyam prayer.
Center-right: Mohammed's arms still angle outward from his sides in a stiff A-pose, and the prayer row remains staggered in depth with the blue-robe boy ahead of the red-cap boy and Mohammed.
tiles.fix: Keep Mohammed and the white-cap boy facing forward in qiyam, align the boys in a straight row, and relax Mohammed's arms against his sides.

worst_problem: In b011 (s04 9.8 and s04 13.7), the sanctuary entrance staging is broken: the oversized little white-robed boy stands stiffly in front of the fqih facing the camera while the other boys cluster near or walk from the tomb instead of following the fqih in through the doorway. | In b014 (s04 34.4 and s04 39.4), the fqih holds a leftover white cloth over his mouth instead of putting a finger to his lips for silence, and then leaves both empty cupped hands hovering stiffly in front of his chest during the boys' ablutions.
